steps.name: a boy whose name is called
steps.objective: Check someone’s conversation in front of the “Windmill on the Hill” in “Whispering Hill.” Then click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Grand Duke, wait.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You somehow managed to find me.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: It wasn't difficult.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Boy, don’t you hate me? I guess they were just using you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Well, thanks, I found what I needed.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: How many days are left for the Archduke to wait for?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I guess you wanted to know that. It's 'soon' now.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I want to help.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How do you help?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, there is nothing the boy can do in the place I am going… . As soon as you step foot there, you will disappear without leaving a single trace of flesh behind... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: So there is someone to call separately… .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It is a flower grown from a seed planted in a mirror. It's cold and warm at the same time.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I don't know if he'll betray me again, but he won't be able to do that there... .
(Barvatos picks the flower and puts it in his arms.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: He refuses with incomprehensible words. okay. So the Archduke is now a god?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was a god from the beginning. This is what it looks like now... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's really difficult to explain. If you really want to help me, just stay quiet and hide. And I hope you don't die until the day we meet again. A boy without a name.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I can't be called a 'nameless boy' forever... I'll give you a gift.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Let me give you the name of someone who was a great warrior like Atalanta.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thank you… Meliager.
(Barvatos taps Noname's shoulder, then jumps onto the windmill and disappears as if flying high into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: This is a person you really don't know even if you know it... . Oh, it's not even a person. Not even a demon... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Meliager… Meliager… . It's a little difficult to pronounce, but it might be okay.

steps.name: need help
steps.objective: Check the story of the customer who came to [Caluso] in the “Invernell Ruins” and click the [Quest Complete] button to end the quest.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Who is there?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's me, Lydia. Uncle Caluso, I told you not to swing your fists anywhere.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I blocked it well with the magic rod, but it was a terrible kill... . So what's going on with the busy Demigod? Daniel and Romalius should be in town.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's more important than checking the two. I need Uncle Caluso's help.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Hello, senior.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What about seniors? What's going on that you even called the priest Dokalf?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Uncle Caluso, this is Askren, the ace of the Immortal Priests and the youngest level 5 priest.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You're crazy about work. How much work have you done before you are already level 5?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Askren Priest, this is Uncle Caluso, a legendary battle priest who is renowned for his achievements in exorcising 10,000 demonic beasts.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's amazing that you can exterminate 10,000 demon beasts. I'm so scared I can't even touch it... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Askren, quiet.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Seeing people gathered like this doesn't seem like an ordinary thing... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Iris's oracle has been granted to %s.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Lend me some strength.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You don't ask any more questions.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Unlike others who are lighter than air.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I won't ask any more questions, but I still need to know where our destination is.

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: Okay, let me tell you. Where we are going is... .

lines.speaker: 리디아
lines.text: It's 'Linford', a piece of heaven and called the city of angels.
